popCulture.title: Bibliotheca
popCulture.creator: Apollodorus
popCulture.description: Apollodorus separates Pandion II from Pandion I: the later Athenian king driven into Megarian exile, father of Aegeus, Pallas, Nisus, and Lycus — the Pandionid split that seeds Attic and Megarian kingship.

popCulture.title: Pandion II
popCulture.description: Legendary king of Athens, son of Cecrops II — exiled to Megara, ancestor of Aegeus; carefully distinct from Pandion I, father of Procne and Philomela.

popCulture.title: Aegeus
popCulture.description: Pandion II's son — the Athenian king who fathers Theseus and gives his name to the Aegean.

popCulture.title: Megara
popCulture.description: The city that shelters Pandion II in exile and later claims his tomb — Megarian memory of the Attic king who ruled from their throne.
